claims.claim: Identity, rigid structure, and declared dimensions match the request.
claims.evidence: request.md requests mug_02, Objaverse UID 4fbb57124fec47d8b216101e19f5d385, one collision mesh and no joints. asset/asset.json and asset/provenance.json match; model.urdf has one base_link and collision.obj. probes/01_geometry_settle.out collision extents are 0.043084 x 0.067525 x 0.064169 m, consistent with readings.json size_cm [4.3,6.8,6.4]. No exact dimensions were requested.

claims.claim: The supplied visual renders agree with the compiled collision orientation.
claims.evidence: renders/front.png and renders/iso.png show a horizontal cup with its handle underneath; renders/top.png shows the side wall rather than the opening. In contrast, probes/02_cavity.out shows visual.glb horizontal sections at z=0 and z=0.03 with inner and outer cup rings, and both meshes have their floor at z approximately -0.02946 and inner floor at -0.02538 m. The compiled geometry therefore has a vertical cup axis. The rendered appearance and tested geometry cannot both describe the same default orientation; visual/collision agreement for the supplied presentation is unresolved.

claims.claim: Compiled cup geometry preserves the central cavity and supports an object inside it.
claims.evidence: probes/02_cavity.out: central downward rays hit collision.obj only at z=-0.025378 and -0.029463 m, matching visual.glb at -0.02537766 and -0.02946263 m. A 10 mm test cube dropped from z=0.12 m settled at [-0.00922,-0.00018,0.01081] m after 150 frames, inside the cup and below its rim. Both meshes report non-watertight; the test establishes central cavity access, not exhaustive surface integrity.

claims.claim: All joint ranges, attachment, and moving-link interference requirements are satisfied.
claims.evidence: Not applicable: readings.json joints is empty and model.urdf contains only base_link with no joints.

claims.claim: All declared handles can be grasped and pulled along their joints.
claims.evidence: Not applicable: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty. The visible mug handle is not an annotated joint actuator. Compiled body width is about 43 mm, below the stated 80 mm gripper opening; no robot pickup was simulated.

claims.claim: All declared place targets support a placed object.
claims.evidence: Not applicable: request.md requires no place targets and readings.json place_targets is empty. The cavity drop was an additional geometry check.

claims.claim: The compiled rigid asset settles upright and remains stable on the ground.
claims.evidence: probes/01_geometry_settle.out: fixed=False, initial position [0,0,0.029463] from exact collision z_min=-0.029463. At cumulative 30,150,300 frames the base pose is [0,-0.00001,0.03014] with rotation Rzz=1.0 and tilt terms at most 0.00017. probes/02_cavity.out confirms the cup axis is Z, so the first script's Y-axis metric named cup_axis_abs_dot_up is inapplicable and is not used for this verdict. The cube-loaded test also retains Rzz=1.0.

metrics.feedback: Resolve the disagreement between renders and compiled geometry before resubmission. Regenerate front, side, top and iso views from the exact current URDF/visual.glb in the documented +Z-up asset frame, and verify that the cup opening faces upward and the handle is beside the cup. If the sideways appearance comes from a visual import axis conversion, correct that conversion so rendered visual and collision geometry coincide. The tested compiled mesh is already upright; do not blindly rotate it based on the supplied images. Preserve the hollow interior and rerun the ground-settling check after any geometry changes.

claims.claim: The asset matches the requested mug identity, rigid structure, and collision representation.
claims.evidence: asset/asset.json identifies mug_02 as rigid; asset/provenance.json records Objaverse UID 4fbb57124fec47d8b216101e19f5d385. asset/model.urdf has one base_link and one collision mesh, collision.obj. All four renders show a cylindrical open mug with a loop handle. probes/01_check.out measures collision dimensions 0.043084 x 0.067525 x 0.064169 m, consistent with readings.json size_cm [4.3, 6.8, 6.4]; request.md specifies no additional numerical size.

claims.claim: The collision mesh approximates the visible mug while preserving the cup cavity and handle opening.
claims.evidence: renders/top.png and renders/iso.png show the cavity and loop handle. probes/01_check.out gives closely matching visual/collision bounds and identical interior floor ray hits at z=-0.025378 m at (0,0) and (0.01,0). probes/02_cavity.out reports no intersections through the handle opening at y=-0.032, z=0 for either mesh. Across 2000 surface samples per direction, collision-to-visual p95/max distances are 0.145/1.779 mm and visual-to-collision p95/max are 2.078/2.641 mm. The collision mesh is not watertight, but the tested cavity remains accessible in runtime: a 10 mm cube reaches world z=0.01091 m inside the mug, whose rim is at world z=0.064706 m, and has supporting mug contacts.

claims.claim: The mug offers an unobstructed body grasp from above within the specified gripper opening.
claims.evidence: readings.json and probes/01_check.out show an X width of 43.084 mm, below the 80 mm gripper opening. renders/top.png, renders/front.png and renders/side.png show exposed opposing body sides with clearance for an approach from above; the loop extends toward negative Y, away from an X-directed body grasp. This is a geometric clearance assessment, not a simulated grasp trial.

claims.claim: Joint travel, attachment, and moving-link interpenetration requirements are satisfied as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no joints; readings.json joints is empty and asset/model.urdf contains only base_link with no joints or moving links.

claims.claim: Joint handle grasp-and-pull requirements are satisfied as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty. The visible mug loop is part of the rigid body, not an annotated handle that operates a joint.

claims.claim: Place-target support requirements are satisfied as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets and readings.json place_targets is empty. The additional cavity probe checks collision accessibility rather than a declared placement target.

claims.claim: The freely placed mug settles and stays upright on the ground.
claims.evidence: probes/01_check.py uses Probe('asset', fixed=False, pos=(0,0,0.029463)), derived from the collision minimum z=-0.029463 m. probes/01_check.out records the same settled position [0,-0.00001,0.03014] m at cumulative frames 30, 150, and 300 (10 seconds). The upright-axis vector is approximately [0.00004,-0.00017,1], a tilt of about 0.01 degrees, with supporting ground contacts throughout.
